Remark
[even codimension of orientation-preserving fixed sets]

Source: petersen:page-0216 ↗ prop:pet-ch5-fixed-point-totally-geodesic 1. ch5:5.6.6If $DF_p:T_pM\to T_pM$ is orientation preserving for $p\in \operatorname {Fix}(F)$, the Zariski tangent space at $p$ has even codimension, since the $+1$-eigenspace of an element of $SO(n)$ has even codimension; so each component of $\operatorname {Fix}(F)$ has even codimension.
